test_parent_child_island_consistency: test that children are added to the same island as their parents in the program database
test_multiple_generations_island_drift: test that children inherit their parent's island across multiple generations of program evolution
test_explicit_migration_override: test that an explicit target_island parameter overrides parent island inheritance when adding a program
run_island_parent_consistency_tests: run the unittest suite to verify island parent-child consistency in the openevolve program database
review_TestIslandParentConsistency: review the TestIslandParentConsistency class and its three test methods for island boundary enforcement
